errors.text_span: Линията започва в точка със стойност 0,84 в 2012 г.
errors.evidence: The line starts at a value of 0.85 in 2012, not 0.84. This is an error of a full gridline.
The value in 2014 is approximately 0.795, halfway between the 0.79 and 0.80 gridlines, not 0.79.
The minimum value in 2016 is approximately 0.788, not 0.78. The stated value is almost a full gridline below the actual data point.
The value in 2020 is slightly above 0.84 (approximately 0.841). Stating it is exactly 0.84 is a minor inaccuracy.
